title: HNF1A POU Domain Mutations Found in Japanese Liver Cancer Patients Cause Downregulation of HNF4A Promoter Activity with Possible Disruption in Transcription Networks.
authors: Haque, Effi; Teeli, Aamir Salam; Winiarczyk, Dawid; Taguchi, Masahiko; Sakuraba, Shun; Kono, Hidetoshi; Leszczynski, Pawel; Pierzchala, Mariusz; Taniguchi, Hiroaki
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝癌中HNF1A POU域突变对HNF4A启动子结合与转录活性的影响，结合结构模拟分析突变对DNA互作的影响，属于TF-DNA互作体系但方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，深度有限。
abstract: Hepatocyte nuclear factor 1A (HNF1A) is the master regulator of liver homeostasis and organogenesis and regulates many aspects of hepatocyte functions. It acts as a tumor suppressor in the liver, evidenced by the increased proliferation in HNF1A knockout (KO) hepatocytes. Hence, we postulated that any loss-of-function variation in the gene structure or composition (mutation) could trigger dysfunction, including disrupted transcriptional networks in liver cells. From the International Cancer Genome Consortium (ICGC) database of cancer genomes, we identified several HNF1A mutations located in the functional Pit-Oct-Unc (POU) domain. In our biochemical analysis, we found that the HNF1A POU-domain mutations Y122C, R229Q and V259F suppressed HNF4A promoter activity and disrupted the binding of HNF1A to its target HNF4A promoter without any effect on the nuclear localization. Our results suggest that the decreased transcriptional activity of HNF1A mutants is due to impaired DNA binding. Through structural simulation analysis, we found that a V259F mutation was likely to affect DNA interaction by inducing large conformational changes in the N-terminal region of HNF1A. The results suggest that POU-domain mutations of HNF1A downregulate HNF4A gene expression. Therefore, to mimic the HNF1A mutation phenotype in transcription networks, we performed siRNA-mediated knockdown (KD) of HNF4A. Through RNA-Seq data analysis for the HNF4A KD, we found 748 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), of which 311 genes were downregulated (e.g., HNF1A, ApoB and SOAT2) and 437 genes were upregulated. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) mapping revealed that the DEGs were involved in several signaling pathways (e.g., lipid and cholesterol metabolic pathways). Protein-protein network analysis suggested that the downregulated genes were related to lipid and cholesterol metabolism pathways, which are implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development. Our study demonstrates that mutations of HNF1A in the POU domain result in the downregulation of HNF1A target genes, including HNF4A, and this may trigger HCC development through the disruption of HNF4A-HNF1A transcriptional networks.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞核因子1A（HNF1A）是肝脏稳态和器官发生的核心调控因子，并调节肝细胞功能的多个方面。它在肝脏中作为肿瘤抑制因子发挥作用，这通过HNF1A敲除（KO）肝细胞中增殖增加得以证实。因此，我们假设基因结构或组成中的任何功能丧失性变异（突变）都可能触发功能障碍，包括肝细胞中转录网络的破坏。从国际癌症基因组联盟（ICGC）癌症基因组数据库中，我们识别出多个位于功能性Pit-Oct-Unc（POU）结构域中的HNF1A突变。在我们的生化分析中，我们发现HNF1A POU结构域突变Y122C、R229Q和V259F抑制了HNF4A启动子活性，并破坏了HNF1A与其靶标HNF4A启动子的结合，而对核定位无影响。我们的结果表明，HNF1A突变体转录活性降低是由于DNA结合受损所致。通过结构模拟分析，我们发现V259F突变可能通过诱导HNF1A N端区域的大构象变化来影响DNA相互作用。结果表明，HNF1A的POU结构域突变下调HNF4A基因表达。因此，为了模拟转录网络中HNF1A突变表型，我们进行了siRNA介导的HNF4A敲低（KD）。通过对HNF4A KD的RNA-Seq数据分析，我们发现了748个差异表达基因（DEGs），其中311个基因下调（如HNF1A、ApoB和SOAT2），437个基因上调。京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）映射显示，这些DEGs涉及多个信号通路（如脂质和胆固醇代谢通路）。蛋白质-蛋白质网络分析表明，下调基因与脂质和胆固醇代谢通路相关，这些通路与肝细胞癌（HCC）发展有关。我们的研究表明，HNF1A在POU结构域中的突变导致HNF1A靶基因（包括HNF4A）的下调，这可能通过破坏HNF4A-HNF1A转录网络而触发HCC发展。
